recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast silhouette of a man in profile facing a setting sun over a dark ocean, featuring ultra-thin, overlapping geometric typography in the upper left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Dark silhouette against a vibrant warm-to-cool gradient sky
Extreme hairline typography overlapping the subject's head
Horizontal horizon line bisecting the lower third of the frame
Text alignment anchored to the top-left corner
coreInvariants: Complete black silhouette of the subject
Ultra-light stroke weight for all text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, standing vertically from bottom to top.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright sun on the horizon acts as the primary light source and focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the sun, moves right to the silhouette, then follows the profile up to the typography in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky provides expansive negative space for the delicate typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the center (sun) fading to lower saturation at the edges; extreme value contrast between sky and silhouette.

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing causing glyphs to touch or overlap
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'W' and 'L' in the primary name are tightly kerned to touch
The 'S' has a very open, wide curve
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different sizes and cases to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric 70s soul aesthetic and tight kerning potential.
Provides the necessary geometric circularity and thin stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A photograph of a man in profile silhouette standing on a beach at sunset. The sun is low on the horizon, creating a vibrant orange and red glow that transitions into a pale blue sky at the top. The ocean is dark and textured with small waves. The man's silhouette is sharp and solid black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of text in the top left corner using an ultra-thin geometric sans-serif font. The middle line should be the largest. Set the tracking very tight so letters almost touch. The text should be white with slight transparency to blend into the sky.

verificationChecks: Is the subject a complete black silhouette?
Does the sky have a smooth gradient from orange to blue?
Is the text positioned in the upper left quadrant?

adjustableVariables: Degree of overlap between text and silhouette
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Record label logos and catalog numbers
Any specific facial features within the silhouette
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite thin stroke
Check that the silhouette has no internal detail
Confirm the color gradient is smooth without banding
recipe.reuseFormula: Silhouette Profile + Sunset Ocean Gradient + Hairline Geometric Typography = Retro Soul Aesthetic
